title: Explain a Small Delay
setting_label: On the way to meet a friend
wrap_friend: 你剛剛用簡單英文說明會晚一點到，並給出一個日常理由。
scenario: You are running a little late and need to explain the reason.
learner_goal: Apologize, give one simple reason, and estimate the delay.
register_notes: Friendly everyday English. Low-stakes delay only; no emergency, workplace, medical, or formal excuse.
support_text: Your friend asks where you are. Say you are sorry, explain the simple reason, and give a short time estimate.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Where are you? Are you close?
turns.speak: Where are you? Are you close?

friend.hint: Your friend is checking where you are. Start with sorry and say you will be a little late.

choices.surface: Sorry, I am going to be a little late.
choices.speak: Sorry, I am going to be a little late.

choices.feedback: Your friend asks about now, not yesterday.

choices.surface: Can you recommend a menu item?
choices.speak: Can you recommend a menu item?
choices.feedback: This is restaurant language. Here you need to explain that you are late.

friend.hint: Give one simple everyday reason. Keep it short.

inline_explain.title: because + reason
inline_explain.explain: Use because to give a simple reason.

choices.feedback: This does not explain why you are late.
Your friend asks for the reason, not for a location.

friend.hint: Use about plus minutes for a simple estimate.

choices.surface: I will be about ten minutes late.
choices.speak: I will be about ten minutes late.

choices.feedback: Ten here should be minutes, not a bus number.
You already said you will be late. Now estimate the time.

friend.hint: Your friend accepts the delay. Say thanks and close naturally.

choices.surface: Thanks. I will be there soon.
choices.speak: Thanks. I will be there soon.

choices.feedback: This sounds like a hotel or restaurant situation, not a delay message.
This is a payment sentence. A simple thanks is better here.

feedback: Distractors separate reason, time estimate, and unrelated scenario language.
tts_segments: Sorry, I am going to be a little late.
I will be about ten minutes late.
Thanks. I will be there soon.
runtime_notes: Fresh EN A2 candidate. Structural checks and two AI semantic review passes completed on 2026-06-14 before metadata promotion.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 brief. KO was used only as schema-shape reference.
notes.a2_boundary: Low-stakes delay with one reason and one estimate; avoids emergency, health, workplace, or formal excuse content.
